biggest_catch: You get nothing until your friend registers via your referral link, opens a First Heritage APEX Rewards Checking account, and within 60 days completes one direct deposit AND twelve debit transactions AND enrolls in eStatements - plus the reward takes up to 30 days to arrive.
catches: Referrer must register for the program and share the offer with friends, family, or coworkers who register via the referral link.

Referred person must open a new First Heritage APEX Rewards Checking Account and, within 60 days of account opening: complete at least 1 direct deposit, complete at least 12 debit card transactions (ATM excluded), and enroll in eStatements.
Referrer limited to five (5) reward bonuses ($500 value) within a calendar year; only one referrer per referred person.
Please allow 30 days for delivery of the reward bonus after all offer requirements are completed.
Reward bonuses may be reported as income to the IRS; offer can be changed at any time without notice.
